content.name: Torpor
entries: A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for {@dice 4d6} hours. The {@condition poisoned} creature is {@condition incapacitated}.

content.name: Torpor
entries: A creature subjected to Torpor poison must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for {@dice 4d6} hours. The creature's {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} is halved while the creature is {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} in this way.
